Container.Name: BrainCutBlur
Container.Overview: Blur-Service for the BrainCut n8n workflow. Automatically blurs faces and license plates in videos via POST API. Called by the n8n workflow and reports back via webhook when done.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Port used by n8n to reach the blur service. Must match the IP configured in the n8n workflow.

Config.Name: BrainCut Ordner
Config.Description: Path to the BrainCut folder on Unraid. Must match the path configured in the n8n workflow (01_input, 02_processing, etc.).

Config.Name: N8N Completion Webhook
Config.Description: URL of the n8n webhook called after all blur jobs complete. Format: http://[n8n-IP]:5678/webhook/blur-done

Config.Name: PLATE_MODEL_PATH
Config.Description: Optional path to a .pt model file for license plate detection (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/braincut-blur/plates.pt). Leave empty if not needed.
